summary: New focused execution requested (validate: valid=true, no_change=false, execution_requested=true, effects: create experiment). The update registers TestAssurance_LiveClusterEmptyConfigRestart against investigation 7e10640e7212486b94a80f04b69febc2-question-1 to convert the live-cluster statement recorded last turn from source-derived to measured, since every earlier measurement of that question used single-node clusters. Design: three voters with RestoreCommittedLogs and a commit-tracking store, eight committed commands, one follower shut down and restarted from its own stores on a fresh transport and reconnected; the probe emits the configuration in force and the follower's staged commit index, the restarted node's recovered configuration/state/term/leader, then what the legitimate leader's continuing heartbeats do to the node's leader view, configuration and log, and finally what one higher-term AppendEntries with no entries from a sender that appears in no configuration does to the node, the serving leader and the cluster. Four comparisons are registered (leader view restored by heartbeats; configuration left empty by heartbeats so only a configuration entry repairs it; an outsider does not become the node's leader; the healthy cluster does not lose its serving leader), with two prerequisite events as admission. A local dry run of the same harness file in the draft work copy compiled and produced: empty recovered configuration with no leader; convergence on the serving leader as true while the configuration stayed empty and a post-restart command was stored; then outsider acceptance true, node term raised to 7, outsider recorded as the node's leader, and the serving leader stepped down with no leader present afterwards. Those local results are a construction check only and are labelled as such in the update; the controller's receipt from this request is the evidence. No interpretation was restated or changed, and no source, hash, contract, baseline or gate was touched.
